author: New China TV
description:
Firefighters carry out high-angle rope rescue training on Mount Huashan in northwest China's Shaanxi Province, with sheer cliffs behind them and a deep drop below.
A salute to those who face danger to keep others safe!
title: Firefighters carrying out high-angle rope rescue training on Mount Huashan

author: New China TV
description: The Organizing Committee of the Asia-Pacific Media Partnership Program was jointly formed by 16 founding organizations from China and abroad at the opening ceremony of the Asia-Pacific Media Forum on Saturday in Shenzhen, south China's Guangdong Province. Forum attendees shared their views on how media can work together to foster regional dialogue and cooperation. #AsiaPacific #MediaCooperation #APEC #China #Shenzhen
title: Vlog | How media cooperation can foster shared prosperity of Asia-Pacific

author: New China TV
description: More than 400 representatives across the Asia-Pacific region and beyond have gathered in Shenzhen, China's innovation hub, for the Asia-Pacific Media Forum. Participants voiced support for stronger regional cooperation and shared development.
title: Asia-Pacific media voice support for stronger regional cooperation, shared development

author: New China TV
description: The first tunnel on the Kyrgyz section of the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway has been drilled through, marking a major milestone in the development of the cross-border route, the project company said Saturday. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | 1st tunnel for China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway achieves breakthrough

author: New China TV
description: "There are more interesting stories (in the Asia-Pacific region) that should be delivered to the world," said Hong Nong, executive director at the Institute for China-America Studies. She spoke at a discussion session on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Media Forum that opened Saturday in Shenzhen, China.
title: More Asia-Pacific interesting stories should be delivered to world: scholar

author: New China TV
description: Nepali rescuers on Saturday rescued a Chinese national from a hydropower plant hit by the deadly mudslide in Nepal, according to the Chinese Embassy in Nepal. #NepalMudslide
title: Chinese national rescued from mudslide-hit hydropower plant in Nepal

author: New China TV
description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping has just wrapped up visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt, during which he also attended a Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit in Bishkek.
The grand ceremonies, major agreements and joint statements drew plenty of attention. But one keyword kept coming up throughout the trip: #AI.
title: An Idea for Shared Development

author: New China TV
description:
"Egyptian-Chinese relations are characterized by a high level of trust between the leaders of the two countries, deep friendship, shared interests, and mutual benefits," said Ezzat Saad, director of the Egyptian Council for Foreign Affairs.
From the #BeltAndRoad Initiative to #BRICS and #SCO, this model partnership aligns closely on global initiatives to champion the development of the #GlobalSouth and advance a multipolar world, said the expert. #Egypt #China #BRI
title: High-level trust drives Egypt-China partnership forward: expert

author: New China TV
description: "China could make a pretty good argument of saying: Well, we've demonstrated the importance of a green transition, renewable energy, and new forms of power..." Mark Beeson, Adjunct Professor with University of Technology Sydney, said in a discussion session on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Media Forum that opened Saturday in Shenzhen, China.
title: Mark Beeson: China's green transition offers experience for APEC

author: New China TV
description: Braving danger, Chinese immigration police officer Xiao Fugui filmed this drone footage near Gyirong Port shortly after a fast-moving chain mudslide triggered by a high-altitude glacier collapse in Nepal struck the border port on Aug. 26. #DroneFootage #Gyirong #GyirongPort #Xizang #China
title: Drone footage captured by Chinese officer shortly after mudslide strikes Gyirong

author: New China TV
description: Cold-water fish farming is sustained by two-millennia-old wells that keep water at 15 to 19 degrees Celsius year-round in Turpan in northwest China's Xinjiang, one of the world's driest and hottest places.
title: Ancient wells fuel cold-water fish farming in China's Xinjiang

author: New China TV
description: A custom-built caisson lifting gear lowered the last of 75 massive caissons for the Pinglu Canal's Anchorage No. 1 in south China's Guangxi. #PingluCanal #China #MegaProject #Guangxi #ASEAN
title: Giant "claw machine" lowers 1,540-ton caisson in south China's Guangxi

author: New China TV
description: Police and local officials used rope to create a rescue route across deep floodwaters in Putian, east China's Fujian Province. Stranded villagers were finally helped to safety after repeated attempts. #FloodRescue #Rescue #Fujian #China #EverydayHero
title: Rope-assisted flood rescue in east China's Fujian

description: What makes traveling in China easier for international visitors? We asked some travelers at Shanghai Pudong Airport about their experiences. #Shanghai #PudongAirport #ChinaTravel
title: Landing in Shanghai: International travelers share their first impressions

author: New China TV
description: "That diversity (of the Asia-Pacific region) should not be seen as an obstacle. It can be a source of strength," said Konstantinos Oikonomou, senior vice president of CNN at the opening of the Asia-Pacific Media Forum. The forum, which opened on Saturday in China's Shenzhen, has brought together more than 400 representatives from the Asia-Pacific region and beyond.
title: Diversity of Asia-Pacific region can be source of strength: CNN senior official

title: Xinhua News | Landslide in east China's Jiangxi leaves 1 dead, 11 missing

author: New China TV
description: "We need journalists for facts. We need facts for trust. And we need trust for a shared reality," said Melissa Fleming, the United Nations under-secretary-general for global communications, in a video address at the opening ceremony of the Asia-Pacific Media Forum held in China's Shenzhen on Saturday.
title: UN official highlights media role in video address at Asia-Pacific Media Forum

author: New China TV
description: This railway could change the future of Central Asia. It will give Kyrgyzstan a new role as a transit hub, connect Uzbekistan more directly with China, and help transform Central Asia into an economic bridge across Eurasia. Here's why the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway matters.
title: EyesOn | The railway that could change Central Asia
